suhoor.name: Middle Eastern Power Bowl
suhoor.description: Ful medames with eggs, tahini, fresh vegetables, and warm pita
suhoor.benefits: High protein and fiber for sustained energy throughout the fast
suhoor.tips: Add a drizzle of olive oil for healthy fats

suhoor.name: South Asian Paratha Breakfast
suhoor.description: Whole wheat paratha with egg curry and lassi
suhoor.benefits: Complex carbohydrates and protein keep you full longer

suhoor.name: Turkish Sahur Spread
suhoor.description: Cheese, olives, eggs, fresh bread, and Turkish tea
suhoor.benefits: Balanced meal with proteins, healthy fats, and carbohydrates
suhoor.tips: Limit caffeine intake; opt for herbal tea if possible

suhoor.name: Indonesian Bubur Ayam
suhoor.description: Savory chicken rice porridge with toppings
suhoor.tips: Prepare the night before for easy morning reheating

suhoor.name: Overnight Oats with Dates
suhoor.description: Steel-cut oats soaked overnight with dates, nuts, and honey
suhoor.benefits: Slow-release energy, easy to digest, no morning cooking needed
suhoor.tips: Add chia seeds for extra fiber and omega-3s

iftar.name: Traditional Date & Water Start
iftar.description: The Prophetic way to break fast - dates and water first
iftar.benefits: Natural sugars provide quick energy; dates are easily digestible
iftar.tips: Eat 1-3 dates and drink water, then pray Maghrib before the main meal

iftar.name: Moroccan Harira Soup
iftar.description: Hearty tomato-based soup with lentils, chickpeas, and fresh herbs
iftar.benefits: Rehydrating, protein-rich, and gentle on the stomach after fasting
iftar.tips: Serve with chebakia (honey cookies) for a traditional experience

iftar.name: Pakistani Fruit Chaat
iftar.description: Refreshing mixed fruit salad with chaat masala and lime
iftar.benefits: Hydrating fruits with electrolytes and vitamins
iftar.tips: Use a variety of colorful fruits for maximum nutrition

iftar.name: Egyptian Konafa
iftar.description: Sweet cheese pastry with crispy kadaif and sugar syrup
iftar.tips: Balance sweet treats with protein-rich main dishes

iftar.name: Arabian Chicken Mandi
iftar.description: Aromatic spiced rice with tender chicken, cooked in traditional style
iftar.benefits: Complete meal with proteins and carbohydrates for recovery
iftar.tips: Serve with raita and fresh salad for balance
